title: Opt-in Personal Mode: server-managed session cookie on a loopback-only lane; remote/tunnel ingress on a separate bearer-only listener (audit remediation: remote isolation + business consistency)
description: Personal Mode (opt-in PAIR_PERSONAL_MODE=local): zero-friction local dashboard without weakening authority. (1) personal-session.ts mints durable digest-persisted sessions bound to the canonical owner — auto-bind one owner, explicit selection across multiple, fresh operator:personal:<id> only when none exist; business eligibility owner-scoped, stale preferences drop. (2) /api/personal/* lane (status/bootstrap/select-owner/business/logout) is exempt from the MC gate but self-guarded by ingress classification + Origin proof; a session cookie is operator-class auth elsewhere ONLY on local ingress, pins the operator (conflict → 403), never satisfies admin/broker/outbox/artifact lanes. (3) classifyPersonalIngress = declared local port + loopback peer + loopback Host + zero proxy marks; spoof/rebind/proxied → remote. (4) serve script runs dual listeners when enabled (loopback lane on PAIR_MC_PORT; bearer-only remote on PAIR_MC_REMOTE_PORT); OFF keeps the legacy listener. (5) start-pair-live.sh points cloudflared at the REMOTE port — the privileged lane is never tunneled. (6) UI-V2: SessionGate bootstraps before /app/* renders (zero prompts), cookie-authed SSE (no ?token= under session), eligible-business picker, connected-state Settings, canonical-owner chip. Live evidence: bootstrap bound operator:op:admin (eligible BIZ_01M5XNM908B9A18ZJ5MB7ZVCY7); cookie read 6 objectives; remote rejected cookie/bootstrap; Host spoof 403; re-bootstrap restored business. Rollback: unset/off → identical legacy bearer. AUDIT REMEDIATION: P1 — cookie evaluated only on local ingress (laneSession), one gate 403s every personal POST on remote ingress before any service call, status() never authenticates on remote → remote GET returns session:null; remote mutations cannot rebind/revoke (G1-G4). P2 — SessionGate mirrors canonical binding (dropped stale preference clears localStorage); BusinessSwitcher commits only after server accepts, keeps prior state + surfaces refusals (H1-H2 + e2e P2).
